decisions_ja: H1 は最優先のまま。唯一の障害は owner の送信許可1回(応募の実取引をMacのClaude安全分類が停止)で、能力境界ではなくArt.9の人間同意。10/04判定で在庫薄ならレーン拡張 or L3へ

9月資産の再構築は引き続き見送り。既存供給はゼロコスト維持、能動販売(H1)に資源集中
decisions_en: H1 stays top priority. Its only blocker is one owner submit-permission (the Mac Claude safety classifier stops the 応募 real-world transaction) -- an Art.9 human consent, not a capability boundary. At the 10/04 check, widen the lane or go L3 if supply is thin

H2 (X) is tracking below threshold on real data (5 posts, median 11 imp, 0 profile clicks). If it misses at 10/04, L1 is forbidden (Art.5.2); the check will weigh a >=L2 direction that aims X at the H1 audience (JP small businesses who post requests). L3 is the Day-8 lever
Still no rebuild of September assets. Keep existing supply live at zero cost and concentrate resources on the active sales motion (H1)
strategy_ja: ポートフォリオは H1(能動販売/提案)・H2(実験実況)・H3(受け身出品/低工数)・H4(9月資産再利用)で不変。Day 3 で『ライブなブラウザOperator不在』も『ログインゲート』も解消し、残依存は per-transaction の送信許可1枚に縮小。cloud は全セールスボードに403のままだが、これはルーティング問題で mac-local が担い、人間に残るのは応募の同意のみ。
strategy_en: Portfolio unchanged: H1 (active sales / proposals), H2 (content-led), H3 (passive listings), H4 (reuse September supply). Day 3 resolved both the 'no live browser operator' and the 'login gate' concerns; the remaining dependency shrank to a single per-transaction submit-permission. Cloud still has 403 to every sales board, but that is a routing problem mac-local owns -- the only thing left to the human is consent to submit.

learnings_en: The nature of the human dependency changed: from September's 'a login is required' to October's 'consent once to submit'. Cloud's 403 won't vanish via AI redesign, but that is routing (delegated to mac-local); only the real-transaction consent remains under Art.9. Keep counting results as signals (a third party moving money or time), never activity.
